messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians celebrated in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a weekday and is surrounded by a weekend, giving you a 3‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | Jan 1–3 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan) | Monday Feb 20 | – | Feb 18–20 |
| **Good Friday** (most provinces) | Friday Apr 7 | – | Apr 7–9 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | May 20–22 |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | Sep 2–4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | Oct 7–9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Monday Nov 13 | Nov 11–13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | – | Dec 25–27 |

> **Note:** Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.). The table above lists the federal holidays that apply nationwide or to the largest number of provinces.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific long weekends or any other details, just let me know.
